query.text: Jane is calling her friend Martha. What time are they going to meet?
Q1 All students in the science club have an activity schedule. What do the students need to do every Tuesday?

explain.text: All students in the science club have an activity schedule for this month. On Mondays, they work together in small groups, and on Thursdays, they have discussions with the teacher. Every Tuesday, however, each student must write a report about what they learned during the week. The reports are important because they help the teacher see how much progress the students are making.

query.text: Q2 A woman is talking about a new computer. Which light shows that the computer is on?

explain.text: Yesterday, I bought a new computer and the shop assistant explained how to use it. She showed me the power button and told me to check the small light next to it. When the computer is turned on, the light turns blue. If the light is off, it means the computer isn't working. There's also a red light for charging and a green one for Wi-Fi, but the blue light is the most important because it shows that the computer is on.

query.text: Q3 A woman is talking about an important meeting. Where does she meet?

explain.text: I have an important meeting this afternoon, so I'm planning my schedule carefully. I'll meet my colleagues to discuss the upcoming festival. At first, we thought about meeting at a café, but then we changed the plan. Now, we all agree to meet at the town hall because it's big and easy to find.

query.text: Q4 A boy is leaving a message for his mother. What did he leave in the yard?

explain.text: Hi Mom, it's me. I just got back from playing football with my friends this afternoon. When I came home, I took off my shoes and left them in the yard because they were really dirty and wet. I was going to wash them, but I forgot. If it rains later, could you please move them inside for me? I'll clean them after dinner. Thanks, Mom. I'll see you at home soon.

query.text: Q5 An announcement is made about today's schedule. Which room will the director's presentation be in?

explain.text: There has been a small change to today's schedule. The director's presentation will not take place in the main hall as planned because the room is being prepared for another event. Instead, everyone should go to the meeting room on the second floor at two o'clock. Please arrive a few minutes early so the presentation can start on time.

query.text: Q6 A man is talking about his homework. What is not working?

explain.text: This morning I needed to finish my homework, so I turned on my computer, but it didn't work. I tried restarting it several times, but the screen stayed black. Then I checked the cables and even called my friend to ask for help, but nothing changed. I think there might be a problem with the battery or the system. Later, I plan to take the computer to a repair shop so they can fix it before my next online class.

query.text: Q7 A man is talking to a group of people. Where are they standing?

explain.text: We're currently standing in the main building complex. Just nearby, you'll see the library — a place where you'll likely spend a lot of your time studying and working on projects. A little further ahead is the main hall, which hosts student elections, performances, and a variety of campus events. If you're looking to stay active, the sports center is located right next to the lecture hall building. Finally, the dormitory is situated just outside the campus, conveniently located across the road.

query.text: Q9 A man is talking about going to the cinema. What time do they meet?

explain.text: I just talked to my friend about our plan for tonight. We want to watch the new movie at the cinema. At first, we thought about meeting at 6:00 pm, but I realized the movie starts a bit later. So, I checked the schedule and decided that 6:30 pm is the perfect time. I'll leave home around 6:00 pm to make sure I'm not late.

query.text: Q10 A woman is giving information at a language center. Which floor is the French class on?

explain.text: Welcome to the language center. Today, all new students should check their classroom information carefully before lessons begin. The French class will not be on the ground floor like last week because those rooms are being repaired. Instead, students need to go to the second floor. There will be signs in the building to help you find the correct classroom more easily.

query.text: Q11 A teacher is talking to the class. What does the teacher want the students to do?

explain.text: I need to talk to some of you about your homework. Over the past few weeks, I have noticed that several assignments were handed in late, and this is starting to affect your progress in class. Completing your work on time is very important because it helps you practice what we learn during lessons. I especially want all students to complete the assignments on time from now on so that their grades can improve before the end of the term.

Q1 A woman is reminding her family about dinner. What time does dinner start?

explain.text: Just a reminder about tonight's family dinner at my grandparents' house. Some people thought it would begin at seven o'clock, but the time has changed slightly because a few family members will arrive later than expected. Dinner will now start at half past seven in the evening. Please try not to be late, because everyone will wait and eat together.

query.text: Q3 A man is talking about tomorrow's meeting. What time do they arrange the meeting?

explain.text: We finally arranged a time for tomorrow's meeting after checking everyone's schedule. At first, we wanted to meet at four o'clock, but some team members were still busy at that time. After discussing a few different options, we agreed to begin the meeting at half past five in the evening. Please try to arrive a little early so we can start on time.

query.text: Q4 A man is talking about his brother's new job. How many days does he have to work?

explain.text: My brother has recently started a new job at a small restaurant in town. At first, he thought he would need to work every weekday, but the manager later explained the schedule more clearly. Because the restaurant is still new, he only has to work three days each week at the moment. He is happy about this because he still has enough free time to continue his studies.

query.text: Q5 A woman is talking about a company trip. Where is she taking the staff to?

explain.text: I'd like to tell you about our company trip next month. This year, we are not visiting another city in our country like before. Instead, we are taking all the staff to a different country for five days. It will be a great chance to relax, learn about a new culture, and spend time together outside work. More information about the trip will be sent by email next week.

query.text: Q6 A student is talking about an exchange program. What country will they study in next semester?

explain.text: Next semester, my friends and I are joining an exchange program from our university. We had several options like Japan, Australia, and Germany. After talking with our teacher, we finally chose France because we want to learn more about French culture and improve our language skills. I'm very excited about studying there and visiting famous places like the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre Museum. It will be a great chance to make new friends and experience a different way of life.

query.text: Q9 A man is talking about how he goes to work. Why does he prefer traveling by train?

explain.text: I've been thinking about how to get to work every day. At first I considered driving, but the traffic is always really bad in the morning. Then I thought about riding my bike, but it's too far, and I'd be tired before I even start my day. The bus is another option, but it's often late. After thinking about all the choices, I decided to travel by train. It's practical because it's on time, and I can relax during the trip. Plus, the station is close to my office.

query.text: Q10 A man is talking about his evening plans. What is this man going to do?

explain.text: After finishing work this evening, Daniel realized he had not eaten anything since lunch. He first thought about going straight home, but he felt too hungry to wait that long. Instead, he decided to stop somewhere in town before going back. He said he was going to get something to eat and then continue with the rest of his evening plans.

Q12 A man is talking about a history project. What does Emma write about?

explain.text: The students in our history class have started working on their final projects for this term. Each student can choose a different topic to research and write about. Some students picked famous people or important events, but Emma decided to focus on land and how it is used in different parts of the country. She said it was an interesting subject because it is connected to farming, housing, and the environment.

query.text: Q13 Listen to a voice message. How does Evan feel?

explain.text: Hi, Evan! This is Mom. I just wanted to leave you a message to check on you. I heard you're not feeling well, and I'm really worried about you. Make sure you're resting and drinking plenty of fluids. Do you need anything? I can bring you some soup or your favorite snacks. Please take care of yourself! I love you and hope you feel better soon. Call me back when you can!
